translations.web: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.
translations.bsb: the priest must come and inspect it. If the mildew has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew; the house is unclean.
translations.kjv: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
translations.asv: then the priest shall come in and look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
